entries.subject: A false color from three measured bands, as the HR 8799 planets have
entries.finding: Carter et al. (2023) measured this planet in seven JWST filters: NIRCam F250M, F300M, F356W, F410M and F444W, and MIRI F1140C and F1550C. Only F410M is among the F410M, F430M and F460M that color HR 8799's planets, so no comparable three-band color exists and the planet is the shared neutral gray.
entries.revisitWhen: Flux densities in three bands comparable with HR 8799's are published.
